ja537:1.1: Kasmā tuvaṃ rasaka edisāni karosi kammāni sudāruṇāni, hanāsi itthī purise ca mūḷho maṃsassa hetu adu dhanassa kāraṇā ti.
ja537:2.1: Na attahetu na dhanassa kāraṇā na puttadārassa sahāyañātinaṃ, bhattā ca me bhagavā bhūmipālo so khādatī maṃsaṃ bhadante edisaṃ.
ja537:3.1: Sace tuvaṃ bhattur atthe payutto karosi kammāni sudāruṇāni pāto va antepuraṃ pāpuṇitvā lapeyyāsi me rājino sammukhe taṃ.
ja537:4.1: Tathā karissāmi ahaṃ bhadante yathā tuvaṃ bhāsasi Kālahatthi, pāto va antepuraṃ pāpuṇitvā vakkhāmi te rājino sammukhe tan
ja537:5.1: ti. Tato ratyā vivasane suriyass' uggamanam pati Kālo rasakam ādāya rājānaṃ upasaṃkami. upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ idaṃ vacanam abravi:
ja537:6.1: Saccaṃ kira mahārāja rasako pesito tayā hanāti itthī purise tuvaṃ maṃsāni khādasi.
ja537:7.1: Evam evaṃ tathā Kāḷa rasako pesito mayā. mama atthaṃ karontassa kim etaṃ paribhāsasīti.
ja537:8.1: Ānando sabbamacchānaṃ khāditvā rasagiddhimā parikkhīṇāya parisāya attānaṃ khādiyā mato.
ja537:9.1: Evaṃ pamatto rasagārave rato bālo yadī āyatiṃ nāvabujjhati vidhamma putte caji ñātake ca parivattiyā attānam eva khādati.
ja537:10.1: Idan te sutvāna vihetu chando, mā bhakkhasī rāja manussamaṃsaṃ, mā tvaṃ imaṃ kevalaṃ vārijo va dipadādhipa suññam akāsi raṭṭhan ti.
ja537:11.1: Sujāto nāma nāmena tassa atrajaoraso jambupesiṃ aladdhāna mato so tassa saṃkhaye.
ja537:12.1: Evam eva ahaṃ Kāḷa bhuttā bhakkhaṃ rasuttamaṃ aladdhā mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ maññe hassāmi jīvitan ti.
ja537:13.1: Māṇava abhirūpo si, kule jāto si sotthiye, na tvam arahasi tāta abhakkhaṃ bhakkhayetave ti g. ā.
ja537:14.1: Rasānaṃ aññataraṃ etaṃ yasmā maṃ tvaṃ nivāraye, so 'haṃ tattha gamissāmi yattha lacchāmi edisaṃ.
ja537:15.1: So vāhaṃ nippatissāmi, na te vacchāmi santike yassa me dassanena tvaṃ nābhinandasi brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja537:16.1: Addhā aññe pi dāyāde putte lacchāma māṇava, tvañ ca jamma vinassasu yattha pattaṃ na [taṃ] suṇomā 'ti g. ā.
ja537:17.1: Evam eva tuvaṃ rāja dipadinda suṇohi me: pabbājessanti taṃ raṭṭhā soṇḍamāṇavakaṃ yathā ti.
ja537:18.1: Sujāto nāma nāmena bhāvitattāna sāvako accharaṃ kāmayanto va na so bhuñji na so pivi.
ja537:19.1: Kusagge udakam ādāya samudde udakaṃ mine evaṃ mānusakā kāmā dibbakāmāna santike.
ja537:20.1: Evam eva ahaṃ Kāḷa bhutvā bhakkhaṃ rasuttamaṃ aladdhā mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ maññe hessāmi jīvitan ti.
ja537:21.1: Yathāpi te dhataraṭṭhā haṃsā vehāsayaṃgamā avuttiparibhogena sabbe abbhatthataṃ gatā
ja537:22.1: Evam eva tuvaṃ rāja dipadinda suṇohi me: abhakkhaṃ rāja bhakkhesi tasmā pabbājayanti tan
ja537:23.1: ti. Tiṭṭhāhīti mayā vutto so tvaṃ gacchasi yammukho, aṭhito ṭhito 'mhīti lapasi brahmacāri idaṃ te samaṇa ayuttaṃ, asiñ ca me maññasi kaṃkapattan ti.
ja537:24.1: Ṭhito 'ham asmi saddhammesu rāja, na nāmagottaṃ parivattayāmi, corañ ca loke aṭhitaṃ vadanti apāyikaṃ nerayikaṃ ito cutaṃ.
ja537:25.1: Sace pi sahasi rāja sutaṃ gaṇhāhi khattiya, tena yaññaṃ yajitvāna evaṃ saggaṃ gamissasīti.
ja537:26.1: Kasmin nu raṭṭhe tava jātibhūmi, atha kena atthena idhānupatto, akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etam atthaṃ, kim icchasī demi tay-ajja patthitan ti.
ja537:27.1: Gāthā catasso dharaṇīmahessara sugambhiratthā varasāgarūpamā, tav' eva atthāya idhāgato 'smi, suṇohi gāthā paramatthasaṃhitā ti.
ja537:28.1: Na ve rudanti matimanto sapaññā bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino, (Cfr. IV 467|12) dīpaṃ hi etaṃ paramaṃ narānaṃ yaṃ paṇḍitā sokanudā bhavanti.
ja537:29.1: Attānaṃ ñāti uda puttadāraṃ dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ kimo nu tvaṃ Sutasomānutappe, Koravyaseṭṭha vacanaṃ suṇoma te ti. Na
ja537:30.1: vāham attānam anutthunāmi na puttadāraṃ na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, satañ ca dhammo carito purāṇo, taṃ saṃgaraṃ brāhmaṇassāṇutappe.
ja537:31.1: Kato mayā saṃgaro brāhmaṇena raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena, taṃ saṃgaraṃ brāhmaṇassa-ppadāya (supra p. 24, 15.) saccānurakkhī punar āvajissan ti.
ja537:32.1: Na vāhaṃ etaṃ abhisaddahāmi: sukhī naro maccumukhā pamutto amittahatthaṃ punar āvajeyya, Koravyaseṭṭha na hi maṃ upehi.
ja537:33.1: Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā (cfr. supra p. 25, 27.) gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmi madhuraṃ piyam jīvitaṃ laddha rāja kuto tuvaṃ ehisi me sakāsan ti.
ja537:34.1: Mataṃ vareyya parisuddhasīlo na jīvitaṃ garahito pāpadhammo, na hi taṃ naraṃ tāyate duggatīhi yassāpi hetū alikaṃ bhaṇeyya.
ja537:35.1: Sace pi vāto giriṃ āvaheyya (IV 462|16) cando ca suriyo ca chamā pateyyuṃ sabbā va najjo paṭisotaṃ vajeyyuṃ na tv-ev' ahaṃ rāja musā bhaṇeyyan ti.
ja537:37.1: Asiñ ca sattiñ ca parāmasāmi, sapatham pi te samma ahaṃ karomi, tayā pamutto anaṇo bhavitvā saccānurakkhī punar āvajissan ti.
ja537:38.1: Yo te kato saṅgaro brāhmaṇena raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena taṃ saṃgaraṃ brāhmaṇassa-ppadāya saccānurakkhī punar āvajassū 'ti g. ā.
ja537:39.1: Yo me kato saṅgaro brāhmaṇena raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena taṃ saṅgaraṃ brāhmaṇassa-ppadāya saccānurakkhī punar āvajissan ti.
ja537:40.1: Mutto ca so porisādassa hatthā gantvāna taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca: suṇoma gāthāyo satārahāyo yā me sutā assu hitāya brahme ti.
ja537:41.1: Sakid eva Sutasoma sabbhi hotu samāgamo, sā naṃ saṃgati pāleti nāsabbhi bahusaṃgamo.
ja537:42.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, (Saṃyuta-N. I. p. 17.) sataṃ saddhammam aññāya seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
ja537:43.1: Jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, (Dhp. v. 151, Saṃyutta-N. I. p. 71.) atho sarīram pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
ja537:44.1: Nabhā ca dūre paṭhavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tad āhu dūre, tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti satañ ca dhammaṃ asatañ ca rājā 'ti.
ja537:45.1: Sahassiyo imā gāthā na imā gāthā satārahā, cattāri tvaṃ sahassāni khippaṃ gaṇhāhi brāhmaṇā 'ti. Asītiyā
ja537:46.1: navutiyā ca gāthā, satārahā cāpi bhaveyyu gāthā, paccattam eva Suttasoma jānāhi sahassiyo nāma kuth' atthi gāthā ti āha.
ja537:47.1: Icchāmi vo 'haṃ sutavuddhim attano, santo ca maṃ suppurisā bhajeyyuṃ, ahaṃ savantīhi mahodadhīva na hi tāta tappāmi subhāsitena.
ja537:48.1: Aggi yathā tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ ḍahanto na tappatī sāgaro vā nadīhi evam pi te paṇḍitā rājaseṭṭha sutvā na tappanti subhāsitena
ja537:49.1: Sakassa dāsassa yadā suṇomi gāthā ahaṃ atthavatī janinda tam eva sakkacca nisāmayāmi, na hi tāta dhammesu mam' atthi tittīti.
ja537:50.1: Idaṃ te raṭṭhaṃ sadhanaṃ sayoggam (289|19) sakāyuraṃ sabbakāmūpapannaṃ, kiṃ kāmahetu paribhāsase maṃ, gacchām' ahaṃ porisādassa kante ti g. ā.
ja537:51.1: Attānurakkhāya bhavanti h' ete hatthārohā rathikā pattikā ca assārohā yeva dhanuggahāse, senaṃ payuñjāma, hanāma sattun ti.
ja537:52.1: Sudukkaraṃ porisādo akāsi: jīvaṃ gahetvāna avassajī maṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ pubbakiccaṃ saranto dubbhe ahaṃ tassa kathaṃ janindā 'ti g. ā.
ja537:53.1: Vanditvā so pitaraṃ mātarañ ca anusāsetvā negamañ [ca] balañ ca saccavādī saccānurakkhamāno agamāsi so yena so porisādo ti.
ja537:54.1: Kato mayā saṃgaro brāhmaṇena raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena, taṃ saṃgaraṃ brāhmaṇassa-ppadāya saccānurakkhī punar āgato 'smi, yajassu yaññaṃ hantvāna mama maṃsaṃ khādāhi vā maṃ samma porisādā 'ti.
ja537:55.1: Na hāyate khādituṃ mayhaṃ pacchā, citakā ayaṃ tāva sadhūmikā va, niddhūmake pacitaṃ sādhu pakkaṃ, suṇāma gāthāyo satārahāyo ti.
ja537:56.1: Adhammiko tvaṃ porisādak' āsi raṭṭhāto bhaṭṭho udarassa hetu, dhammañ c' imā abhivadanti gāthā, dhammo adhammo ca kuhiṃ sameti.
ja537:57.1: Adhammikassa luddassa niccaṃ lohitapāṇino n' atthi saccaṃ kuto dhammaṃ, kiṃ sutena karissasīti.
ja537:58.1: Yo maṃsahetu migavaṃ careyya yo cāhane purisaṃ attahetu ubho pi te pecca samā bhavanti, kasmā no adhammikaṃ brūsi maṃ tvan ti.
ja537:59.1: Pañca pañca na khā bhakkhā khattiyena pajānatā, abhakkhaṃ rāja bhakkhesi, tasmā adhammiko tuvan ti.
ja537:60.1: Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī amittahatthaṃ punar āgato si, nakkhattadhamme kusalo si rājā 'ti.
ja537:61.1: Ye khattadhamme kusalā bhavanti pāyena te nerayikā bhavanti, tasmā ahaṃ khattadhammaṃ pahāya saccānurakkhī punar āgato 'smi, yajassu yaññaṃ khāda maṃ porisādā 'ti.
ja537:62.1: Pāsādavāsā paṭhavīgavāssaṃ kāmitthiyo kāsikacandanañ ca sabbaṃ tahiṃ labbhati sāmitāya, saccena kiṃ passasi ānisaṃsan ti.
ja537:63.1: Ye kec' ime atthi rasā pathavyā saccaṃ tesaṃ sādhutaraṃ rasānaṃ, sacce ṭhitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca taranti jātimaraṇassa pāran ti.
ja537:64.1: Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī amittahatthaṃ punar āgato si, na ha nūna te maraṇabhayaṃ janinda, alinacitto c' asi saccavādīti.
ja537:65.1: Katā me kalyāṇā anekarūpā, yaññā yiṭṭhā ye vipulā pasatthā, visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
ja537:66.1: Katā me kalyāṇā anekarūpā, yaññā yiṭṭhā ye vipulā pasatthā, anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ khāda maṃ porisāda.
ja537:67.1: Pitā ca mātā ca upaṭṭhitā me, dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ, visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
ja537:72.1: Dinnaṃ me dānaṃ bahudhā bahunnaṃ, santappitā samaṇā brāhmanā ca, anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ khāda maṃ porisādā 'ti.
ja537:73.1: Visaṃ pajānaṃ puriso adeyya āsīvisaṃ jalitaṃ uggatejaṃ, muddhāpi tassa vipateyya sattadhā yo tādisaṃ saccavādiṃ adeyyā 'ti.
ja537:74.1: Sutvā dhammaṃ vijānanti narā kalyāṇapāpakaṃ, api gāthā suṇitvāna dhamme me ramatī mano ti.
ja537:75.1: Sakideva Sutasoma sabbhi hotu samāgamo, sā naṃ saṃgati pāleti nāsabbhi bahusaṃgamo.
ja537:76.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam aññāya seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
ja537:77.1: Jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīram pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
ja537:78.1: Nabhā ca dūre paṭhavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tad āhu dūre, tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti satañ ca dhammaṃ asatañ ca rājā 'ti.
ja537:79.1: Gāthā imā atthavatī suvyañjanā (151|10) subhāsitā tuyhaṃ janinda sutvā ānandicitto sumano patīto, cattāri te samma vare dadāmīti.
ja537:80.1: Yo n' attano maraṇaṃ bujjhasi tvaṃ hitāhitaṃ vinipātañ ca saggaṃ giddho rase duccarite niviṭṭho kiṃ tvaṃ varaṃ passasi pāpadhamma.
ja537:81.1: Ahañ ca taṃ dehi varan ti vajjaṃ tvañ cāpi datvāna avākareyya, sandiṭṭhikaṃ kalaham imaṃ vivādaṃ ko paṇḍito jānam upabbajeyyā 'ti.
ja537:82.1: Na taṃ varaṃ arahati jantu dātuṃ yaṃ vāpi datvāna avākareyya, varassu samma avikampamāno, pāṇaṃ cajitvāna pi dassam evā 'ti.
ja537:83.1: Ariyassa ariyena sameti sakkhi paññassa paññāṇavatā sameti, passeyya taṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ, etaṃ varānaṃ paṭhamaṃ varāmīti.
ja537:84.1: Ariyassa ariyena sameti sakkhi paññassa paññāṇavatā sameti, passe pi maṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ, etaṃ varānaṃ paṭhamaṃ dadāmīti.
ja537:85.1: Ye khattiyā ye idha bhūmipālā muddhābhisittā katanāmadheyyā na tādise bhūmipatī adesi, etaṃ varānaṃ dutiyaṃ varāmīti.
ja537:86.1: Ye khattiyā ye idha bhūmipālā muddhābisittā katanāmadheyyā na tādise bhūmipatī ademi, etaṃ varānaṃ dutiyaṃ dadāmīti.
ja537:87.1: Parosataṃ khattiyā te gahītā talāvutā assumukhā rudantā, sake te raṭṭhe paṭipādayāhi, etaṃ varānaṃ tatiyaṃ varāmīti.
ja537:88.1: Parosataṃ khattiyā me gahītā talāvutā assumukhā rudantā, sake te raṭṭhe paṭipādayāmi, etaṃ varānaṃ tatiyaṃ dadāmīti.
ja537:89.1: Chiddan te raṭṭhaṃ vyādhitaṃ bhayāhi, puthū narā lenam anuppaviṭṭhā, manussamaṃsaṃ viramehi rāja, etaṃ varānaṃ catutthaṃ varāmīti.
ja537:90.1: Addhā hi so bhakkho mamaṃ manāpo, etassa hetum pi vanaṃ paviṭṭho, so 'haṃ kathaṃ etto upārameyyaṃ, aññaṃ varānaṃ catutthaṃ varassū 'ti.
ja537:91.1: Na ve piyaṃ me ti janinda tādiso (III 280|3) attaṃ niraṃkatvā piyāni sevati, attā va seyyo paramā va seyyo, labbhā piyā ocitatthena pacchā ti.
ja537:92.1: Piyaṃ me mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ Sutasoma vijānahi, n' amhi sakko nivāretuṃ aññaṃ tuvaṃ samma varaṃ varassū 'ti.
ja537:93.1: Yo ve piyaṃ me ti piyānukaṃkhī attaṃ niraṃkatvā piyāni sevati soṇḍo va pītvāna visassa thālaṃ ten' eva so hoti dukkhī parattha.
ja537:94.1: Yo c' īdha saṃkhāya piyāni hitvā kicchena pi sevati ariyadhammaṃ dukkhito va pītvāna yathosadhāni ten' eva so hoti sukhī paratthā 'ti.
ja537:95.1: Ohāy' ahaṃ pitaraṃ mātarañ ca manāpike kāmaguṇe ca pañca etassa hetumhi vanaṃ paviṭṭho, tan te varaṃ kin ti-m-ahaṃ dadāmīti.
ja537:96.1: Na paṇḍitā diguṇaṃ āhu vākyaṃ, saccappaṭiññā ca bhavanti santo, varassu samma iti maṃ avoca, icc-abravī tvaṃ na hi te sametīti.
ja537:97.1: Apuññalābhaṃ ayasaṃ akittiṃ pāpaṃ bahuṃ duccaritaṃ kilesaṃ manussamaṃsassa kate upāgā, tan te varaṃ kin ti-m-ahaṃ dadeyyan ti.
ja537:98.1: Na taṃ varaṃ arahati jantu dātuṃ yaṃ vāpi datvāna avākareyya, varassu samma avikampamāno, pāṇaṃ jahitvāna pi dassam evā 'ti.
ja537:99.1: Pāṇañ cajanti santo nāpi dhammaṃ, saccappaṭiññā ca bhavanti santo, datvā varaṃ khippam avākarohi etena sampajja surājaseṭṭha.
ja537:100.1: Caje dhanaṃ yo pana aṅgahetu aṅgaṃ caje jīvitaṃ rakkhamāno, aṅgadhanaṃ jīvitaṃ cāpi sabbaṃ caje naro dhammam anussaranto ti.
ja537:101.1: Yassāpi dhammaṃ puriso vijaññā ye c' assa kaṃkhaṃ vinayanti santo taṃ hi 'ssa dīpañ ca parāyanañ ca na tena mittiṃ jarayetha pañño ti
ja537:102.1: gātham āha. Addhā hi so bhakkho mamaṃ manāpo, etassa hetum pi vanaṃ paviṭṭho, sace va maṃ yācasi etam atthaṃ etam pi te samma varaṃ dadāmīti.
ja537:103.1: Satthā ca me hosi sakkhā ca me si, vacanam pi te samma ahaṃ akāsiṃ, tuvaṃ pi me samma karohi vākyaṃ, ubho pi gantvāna pamocayāmā 'ti.
ja537:104.1: Satthā ca te homi sakhā ca ty-amhi, vacanam pi me samma tuvaṃ akāsi, aham pi te samma karomi vākyaṃ, ubho pi gantvāna pamocayāmā 'ti vatvā
ja537:105.1: Kammāsapādena viheṭhitattā talāvutā assumukhā rudantā, na jātu dubbhetha imassa rañño, saccappaṭiññaṃ me paṭissuṇāthā 'ti.
ja537:106.1: Kammāsapādena viheṭhit' amhā talāvutā assumukhā rudantā, na jātu dubbhema imassa rañño, saccappaṭiññan te paṭissuṇāmā 'ti.
ja537:107.1: Yathā pitā vā athavāpi mātā anukampakā atthakāmā pajānaṃ evam eva no hotu ayañ ca rājā, tumhe ca vo hotha yath' eva puttā ti.
ja537:108.1: Yathā pitā vā athavāpi mātā anukampakā atthakāmā pajānaṃ evam eva no hotu ayañ ca rājā, mayam pi hessāma tath' eva puttā ti.
ja537:109.1: Catuppadaṃ sakuṇañ cāpi maṃsaṃ sūdehi randhaṃ sukataṃ suniṭṭhitaṃ sudhaṃ va Indo paribhuñjiyāna hitvā kath' eko ramasī araññe.
ja537:110.1: Tā khattiyā vellivilākamajjhā alaṃkatā samparivārayitvā Indaṃ va devesu pamodayiṃsu hitvā kath' eko ramasī araññe.
ja537:111.1: Tambūpadhāne bahugoṇakamhi sucimhi sabbasayanamhi saññate sayanassa majjhamhi sukhaṃ sayitvā hitvā kath' eko ramasī araññe.
ja537:112.1: Pāṇissaraṃ kumbhathūnaṃ nisīthe atho pi ve nippurisam hi turiyaṃ bahuṃ sugītañ ca suvāditañ ca hitvā kath' eko ramasī araññe.
ja537:113.1: Uyyānasampannaṃ pahūtamalyaṃ migācirūpetapuraṃ surammaṃ hayehi nāgehi ratheh' upetaṃ hitvā kath' eko ramasī araññe.
ja537:114.1: Kāḷapakkhe yathā cando hāyat' eva suve seve kāḷapakkhūpamo rāja asataṃ hoti samāgamo.
ja537:115.1: Yathāhaṃ rasakam āgamma sūdakaṃ purisādhamaṃ akāsiṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ yena gacchāmi duggatiṃ.
ja537:116.1: Sukkapakkhe yathā cando vaḍḍhat' eva suve suve sukkapakkhūpamo rāja sataṃ hoti samāgamo.
ja537:117.1: Yathāhaṃ tavam āgamma Sutasoma vijānahi kāhāmi kusalaṃ kammaṃ yena gacchāmi suggatiṃ.
ja537:118.1: Thale yathā vārijanindavaṭṭaṃ anaddhaneyyaṃ aciraṭṭhitīkaṃ evam pi ce hoti asataṃ samāgamo anaddhaneyyo udakaṃ thale va.
ja537:119.1: Sare yathā vārijanindavaṭṭaṃ ciraṭṭhitīkaṃ naraviriyaseṭṭha evam pi ce hoti sataṃ samāgamo ciraṭṭhitīko udakaṃ sare va.
ja537:120.1: Avyāyiko hoti sataṃ samāgamo, yāvam pi tiṭṭheyya tath' eva hoti, khippaṃ hi veti asataṃ samāgamo, tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā ti.
ja537:121.1: Na so rājā yo ajeyyaṃ jināti, na so sakhā yo sakhāraṃ jināti, na sā bhariyā yā patino vibheti, na te puttā ye na bharanti jiṇṇaṃ.
ja537:122.1: Na sā sabhā yattha na santi santo, na te santo ye na bhaṇanti dhammaṃ, rāgañ ca dosañ ca pahāya mohaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇantā va bhavanti santo.
ja537:123.1: Nābhāsamānaṃ jānanti missaṃ bālehi paṇḍitaṃ, bhāsamānañ ca jānanti desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
ja537:124.1: Bhāsaye jotaye dhammaṃ, paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ, subhāsitadhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo ti.
